details: paystation-embed-app 1.0.0 has no functional code; its description is "security testiong only". Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5`, telling the collector the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account djdhhdjdjf7777, which published the same beacon as bundle-entry-points, use-sync-external-store-shim and global-error-handling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
